messages.subject: Problem getting input event
parts:
I have created a datatable and want to create a button to perform an server action of saving row to a database. While I rather use a standard button, I am currently created check boxes in each row named row1...row20 with value of row index. My main problem is I only get observe called for the first row, and even for that case it is not clear to me how to get value. Any ideas?

## from stack overflow
rowSelect <- reactive({ paste(sort(unique(input[["rows"]])),sep=',') })

observe({
##What I want to do is rowData[checkBoxIndex] how?
})

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Problem getting input event
parts:
I'd just make 20 observers, one for each row (and do make sure to use lapply instead of for, the latter will share a single i variable among all the observers which you most definitely don't want):

lapply(1:20, function(i) {
  observe({
    if (!isTRUE(input[[paste0("row", i)]]))
      return()
    isolate({
      # save the data from row i to the database
    })
  })
})

That didn't work for me.  I do not get any action, and get unexpected debug output only during init, and nothing if I check box.  What am I missing?

library(shiny)

ui <- shinyUI(
    fluidPage(theme = "bootstrap.css",
              h1("Latest Results"),
              dataTableOutput("dt")

              )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

results = mtcars

  row_index <-  1:nrow(results)
  addButtons <- paste0('<input type="checkbox" name="row',
                       row_index, '" value="', row_index, '">',"")
  results = cbind(row_index, add=addButtons, results)

  cat("Creating ",nrow(results),"Rows\n", file=stderr())

  output$dt <- renderDataTable(results)

  lapply(1:20, function(i) {
    observe({
      cat("called row ",i," x ",input[[paste0("row", i)]],"\n",file=stderr())
    })
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
